Name: FIFA Ranking Difference (Away rank - Home rank)
Reason: Official summary of recent results and opponent strength; better-ranked teams should outscore weaker ones.
Source: FIFA Men's World Ranking, 11 Jun 2026 (inside.fifa.com; cross-checked with MLSsoccer, ESPN)

Name: Squad Market Value Difference (EUR m, Home - Away)
Reason: Market value prices individual quality and depth; richer squads should win by more.
Source: Transfermarkt values via Planet Football (values identical in articles dated 16 Jun, 18 Jun, 15 Jul, 28 Jul 2026)

Name: Squad Average Age Difference (years, Home - Away)
Reason: Older squads bring experience but lose pace and stamina; effect direction is ambiguous, so no strong prior.
Source: Official 26-man FIFA squads announced 2 Jun 2026 (RotoWire, CBS Sports)

Name: Prior World Cup Best Result Difference (ordinal 1-8)
Reason: Tournament pedigree reflects football culture and big-match experience.
Source: FIFA World Cup records (Czechoslovakia->Czechia, West Germany->Germany, Zaire->DR Congo)

Name: Qualifying Goal Difference (Home - Away)
Reason: Goal difference over 2023-25 qualifiers is a pre-tournament proxy for attacking and defensive form.
Source: Wikipedia 2026 FIFA World Cup qualification pages (all confederations); hosts set to 0 (assumption)

Name: Host Advantage Difference (1 / 0 / -1)
Reason: Hosts play on home soil with crowd support and no travel.
Source: Tournament hosting arrangement: USA, Mexico, Canada

Name: Confederation Strength Difference (tier 1-6)
Reason: Teams from stronger confederations face tougher competition and tend to perform better at World Cups.
Source: Author-assigned ordinal tier from historical World Cup results (not an official metric)

Name: Rest Days Difference (Home - Away)
Reason: More recovery time between matches should reduce fatigue and injury risk.
Source: Computed from the verified match schedule; opening matches assumed 14 days
